correctness.rationale: For u=(x/a)^2, K'' is proportional to (3u-1)/(1+u)^3+W(3u-t)/(u+t)^3, with t=(b/a)^2 and W=(b/a)(1-w)/w. Its roots are R_t(u)=W on (1/3,t/3). Independently differentiated R_t' and verified exact factor 6(t-1)(u+t)^2[5u^2-(t+1)u+t]/[(t-3u)^2(u+1)^4]. Discriminant t^2-18t+1 yields sharp t*=9+4sqrt5; monotonicity and endpoint limits give two/four/six distinct real roots and double/triple transition multiplicities. Exact rational quartic witness for (a,b,w)=(1,5,1/37) has three distinct positive roots. The proof, not finite evaluations, covers the entire continuum.
